name: Human
description: Ubiquitous, adaptable, and everywhere you look.

lineages.name: Human
lineages.description: From one of the river cities, most likely.

name: Dwarf
description: Short, broad, and from somewhere with a ceiling.

lineages.name: Hill Dwarf
lineages.description: Weathered, from the terrace farms above the delvings.

lineages.name: Mountain Dwarf
lineages.description: Pale, from the deep halls, and unhurried about it.

lineages.name: High Elf
lineages.description: Raised among libraries and very sure of it.

lineages.name: Wood Elf
lineages.description: Raised somewhere with no roads and no interest in any.

lineages.name: Lightfoot Halfling
lineages.description: Hard to notice leaving, harder to notice arriving.

lineages.name: Stout Halfling
lineages.description: Built like a barrel and about as easy to move.
